name: dependency-upstream
command: const names=["js-yaml","argparse","@expo/cli","@expo/code-signing-certificates","decode-uri-component"]; for(const n of names){const r=await fetch("https://registry.npmjs.org/"+encodeURIComponent(n));const d=await r.json();console.log(JSON.stringify({name:n,tags:d["dist-tags"],recent:Object.keys(d.versions).slice(-6),current:d.versions[d["dist-tags"].latest]}));}
